choice: html, css and js files must be served with text/html, text/css and text/javascript (or application/javascript) Content-Types; a NUL byte in the path must get an error status without crashing the server; a zero-area bbox (south == north) is valid
text: Which static-file and bbox behaviors not spelled out in the spec do the acceptance tests require?
why: Browsers refuse ES module scripts with other MIME types, so app.js would not load; the server must never crash on a handler error; parseBbox only rejects south > north and west > east.
